jun.role: Jun, tech lead — friendly, fast, trusts the process

segments.text: Hey, I'm Jun, your tech lead. Welcome to the team. We've got a new build coming our way, a citizen feedback portal, and the goal is to take it from idea to production fast. You won't be doing this alone. The rest of the team and a coding agent are on it with us, and the agent handles the heavy lifting on implementation.
Your role is the one that matters most. You make the calls. The agent proposes and you verify, at every phase. We'll move through three phases: Inception, Construction, and Operation.
Nice pace. Don't skip a gate to go faster. That's how it breaks later.
Portal restored on day one. And a new check is in the plan, so it can't happen again.
Idea to production in five minutes. The AI planned, built and investigated. You made every call that mattered.
That's AI-DLC. The AI proposes. The humans decide.
Time's up. The sprint is over.
No stress. Even good squads miss a sprint. Run it again. You'll be faster now that you know the gates.
